description: No kernel change. ncu SpeedOfLight at autotuned config (m05600_sxx, vec8): Compute(SM)/ALU=97.59%, Executed IPC=2.11 (== GA10x int32 half-rate ceiling; matches RIPEMD-160 2.06 / SHA-2 2.08 family roofline), Issue Slots Busy 52.8%, occupancy 50% register-limited (Block Limit Registers=3) but ALU pipe already saturated -> occupancy-lift is a non-factor. NetNTLMv2 = MD4(pw) + 2x HMAC-MD5 = 9 ARX transforms/candidate, ALL candidate-dependent: both HMAC keys vary (k1=MD4(pw), k2=inner-HMAC output), so no cross-candidate or constant-message precompute is possible (esalt userdomain/chall msgs are constant but the key-dependent MD5 state entering each message block varies). Step funcs already minimal single-LOP3: MD5 F/G=bitselect, H=XOR3, I=y^(x|~z), MD4 F/G/H likewise; MD5_STEP_S lowers to IADD3+LOP3+SHF+IADD (canonical-minimal, no stray MOV/IMAD). Prior-win playbook all inapplicable: table-shrink N/A (no tables), dependency-chain/shared-mem N/A (97.6% ALU, not latency/LSU-bound), Keccak-style hand-fused XOR3 N/A (no CSE-split XOR chain; the 3-input bool funcs are single macros ptxas already fuses to 1 LOP3), PRMT byte-rotate offload N/A (MD4/MD5 rotate amts 3/5/7/9/11/12/17/22... none byte-aligned, no PRMT target), occupancy-lift N/A (ALU saturated at 50%% occ). No untried lever with positive EV -- 32-bit MD/NTLM ARX family at instruction+pipe roofline per program guidance. Fresh baseline 4660.0 (== 4654.4 within noise).

Deeper re-audit, no kernel change (fresh baseline 4648.2 == prior 4654-4660 within noise). NEW findings beyond prior roofline row: (1) outer-HMAC feedforward-reversal N/A -- each outer MD5 compression input state = candidate-dependent opad state (not a host-known constant), so the classic skip-final-adds / compare-vs-(search-IV) trick cannot apply anywhere here; (2) pure-vs-optimized kernel audited: identical compression schedule, only diffs are message staging into __local + SIMD vec -- neither cuts int-instruction count and staging is moot at 97.6pct ALU (not mem/LSU-bound); (3) HMAC msg update hits the pos==0 fast path (ipad exactly 64B, ctx->len=64) so no switch_buffer byte-realign ALU overhead exists to remove; (4) MD4 transform also instruction-minimal (Fo=bitselect 1-LOP3, Go=2-op majority, H=XOR3) matching MD5; (5) MD5_STEP_S 12 constant pad/length W fold K+x via ptxas reassoc. No untried lever with +EV that avoids editing shared inc_hash_md5.cl (would risk whole MD5/HMAC family for 0 expected gain). At int32-pipe roofline (IPC 2.11 = GA10x half-rate ceiling); stop.

Removed provably-dead re-zeroing of w1/w2/w3 in m05600_a3-pure (both sxx+mxx) before the 2nd HMAC init: those arrays are set to 0 by the first init and never written since (md5_hmac_init_64 takes them const; update/final touch only ctx), so the second zeroing is dead. Value-identical, selftest PASS. 4655.6 == baseline 4654.4 within ~1-2% noise -> discard: ptxas already dead-store-eliminates it, so no reg-liveness relief materialized. FIRST empirical kernel-edit data point for m5600 (prior 3 rows were reasoning/no-change baselines). Confirms the kernel body is pure glue: ALL compute lives in shared MD4/MD5 headers, so any real lever would require editing inc_hash_md5.cl and risking the entire MD5/HMAC family for 0 expected gain. Reconfirms ALU-roofline (97.6%% ALU / IPC 2.11).

MD5 round-3 rotl16 (MD5S22=16) offloaded from SHF to PRMT via hc_byte_perm_S(a,0,0x1032) in scalar md5_transform (4 s=16 steps/transform, ~10 transforms/candidate). CORRECTS prior roofline rows factual error ("no byte-aligned rotate in MD4/MD5, no PRMT target") -- MD5 round 3 DOES rotate by 16 (byte-aligned). PRMT is value-identical to rotl16 (verified vs hc_swap32_S 0x0123 convention); selftest PASS confirms. 4646.5 == baseline 4654.4 within ~1-2% noise (-0.17%, actually flat/slightly under) -> discard. Matches m6000 RIPEMD-160 PRMT precedent (-0.6% noise). Root cause: m5600 is INT-datapath/LOP3-bound (97.6% ALU, IPC 2.11=GA10x int32 half-rate cap), NOT SHF-bound; only 4/64 rotates qualify for PRMT (~1.5% of INT ops) so relieving SHF cannot move an ALU-roofline kernel (unlike SHF-bound SM3 +3.2%). LAST open PRMT lever now empirically closed; reconfirms ALU-roofline. Reset.

Round audited the 2 remaining untried kernel-body levers; both principled-CLOSED (no edit, fresh baseline 4637.5 == prior 4648-4660 within noise). (1) MD4 w0-invariant PRECOMPUTE-HOIST: in the inner IL loop only w[0] varies (w0lr=w0l|w0r), but MD4 mixes w[0] at step 0 (a=ROTL(a+F(b,c,d)+w[0],3)) so every later step is w0-dependent -- no invariant transform-prefix to hoist out of the loop, only the constant IV load (which ptxas already hoists). (2) UTF16-EXPANSION-HOIST: md4_update_utf16le re-expands the invariant pw tail every iteration, BUT make_utf16le_S lowers to 8 hc_byte_perm_S = PRMT ops on the SHF/PRMT pipe, a SEPARATE issue port from the ALU/LOP3 pipe (cf prmt-offloads-shf-pipe-sm86). This kernel is 97.6pct ALU/LOP3-bound, so the PRMT UTF16 work overlaps the ALU roofline for FREE -- hoisting it relieves the non-bottleneck port => 0 expected gain (same reason row6 PRMT-rotl16 offload was -0.17pct noise). Both untried levers now closed on top of prior 2 real-edit discards (dead w-rezero DCE, PRMT rotl16) + 3 roofline rows. NetNTLMv2 = MD4 + 2x HMAC-MD5, all 9+ ARX transforms candidate-dependent, no precompute, no CSE-split XOR3 to fuse, no table to shrink, occupancy-lift a non-factor at 50pct occ ALU-saturated. At int32-pipe roofline (IPC 2.11 = GA10x half-rate cap). STOP.

Concretely closed the last memory-flagged open MD4/MD5-family lever: s04 reverse-from-target early-out DEPTH (won +3.1%% on m1000 raw-MD4). Prior m5600 row4 dismissed feedforward-reversal by hand-wave; this round checked it against the OUTER HMAC-MD5 final transform`s actual round-4 message schedule (word order 0,7,14,5,12,3,10,1,8,15,6,13,4,11,2,9 over [inner_digest16B,0x80,0..,len=0x280]): last steps use step60=w4=0x80, step61=w11=0, step62=w2=inner-digest-word(CANDIDATE-DEPENDENT), step63=w9=0. Two independent blockers vs m1000: (1) opad feedforward IV is candidate-dependent (=MD5(MD4(pw) key-derived opad state)), so the reversed compare-target (search[]-opad_state) CANNOT be host-precomputed/compile-baked the way m1000 bakes it from MD4`s fixed IV; (2) the constant-message tail is only 1 step deep (w2@step62 is candidate-dependent), so at most step63 (w9=0) is cheaply reversible = ~1 MD5 step << 1-2%% noise. m1000 won precisely because it had BOTH constant IV AND a deep constant tail; m5600 has NEITHER. Also re-audited: md5_hmac_init_64 w1=w2=w3=0 already constant-folds ^0x36/^0x5c to 0x36363636/0x5c5c5c5c (ptxas); deferring r1/r2/r3 feedforward adds until r0 matches saves only 3 IADD/candidate (<0.5%%). Fresh baseline 4656.1 == prior 4654-4660 within noise. NetNTLMv2 = MD4 + 2x HMAC-MD5, 9 candidate-dependent ARX transforms, 97.6%% ALU / IPC 2.11 (GA10x int32 half-rate cap). At int32-pipe roofline; every remaining lever now empirically or concretely closed. STOP.
